label: hedge move ARRIVAL ESTIMATE from the PROBE at a FIXED 130 ms delay from the fill, 7 TRAIN days: the SENSITIVITY case (owner 6 Nov: run v1_2 with -0.862 at the Phase B freeze); EXPLORATORY
method: PROBE: one 1 SOL Bybit bid per 15 s slot at the strategy's quote depth (qv2_probe.py, v1.1 fill rules, 00:00-02:00 UTC slice of each day); bid = the Binance mid move (bps) from each simulated probe fill to fill + 130 ms, mean over all fills. The 130 ms is an ASSUMED hedge arrival delay, a SENSITIVITY value well above the singapore preset's 31-52 ms, NOT measured on mainnet. The probe is bid-only: the ask value is the market-data value, carried over unchanged and unused while maker_passive_side is bid
window: fixed delay from the fill, ASSUMED arrival estimate

bid.note: se_bps treats fills as independent and understates; read se_day_block_bps (7 day blocks)
